title: Create HeroSection Component
description: Develop a new reusable HeroSection React component for the landing page.
details:

test_strategy: Manually verify the component renders with correct structure and content. Use Storybook or similar to check visual appearance and responsiveness. Optionally, write a Jest/React Testing Library test to confirm headline, sub-headline, and CTA presence.

title: Integrate CTA Button with Navigation
description: Add a prominent call-to-action button to the HeroSection that navigates to the sign-up page.
details: Within the HeroSection component, import and use the Button component from components/ui/button.tsx. Wrap the Button with Next.js's Link component, setting the href to '/sign-up'. Ensure the button is visually prominent and accessible (focusable, labeled).
test_strategy: Test that the CTA button is rendered, is keyboard accessible, and clicking it navigates to /sign-up. Use React Testing Library or Playwright for navigation test.

title: Integrate HeroSection into Landing Page
description: Render the new HeroSection component at the top of the main landing page.
details: Import the HeroSection component into app/page.tsx. Place it as the first section in the page layout, above other landing page sections. Ensure there are no layout or style conflicts with existing content.
test_strategy: Manually verify that the HeroSection appears at the top of the landing page and does not break existing layout. Optionally, write a test to confirm its presence in the DOM.

title: Validate Responsiveness and Accessibility
description: Ensure the HeroSection is fully responsive and accessible across devices and screen readers.
details: Test the HeroSection on various screen sizes (mobile, tablet, desktop) to confirm responsive behavior. Use accessibility tools (e.g., Lighthouse, axe) to check for color contrast, ARIA roles, and keyboard navigation. Adjust Tailwind classes and markup as needed to address any issues.
test_strategy: Use browser dev tools to simulate different devices. Run automated accessibility audits. Manually test keyboard navigation and screen reader output.
